about: Findings from inspecting the story artwork by eye (Prompt 18). Read into docs/ART_ASSET_AUDIT.md by scripts/art/story_assets.py.
missing: No character sprite sheet for **Jak** (Jak Gold): his quest-item atlas, parlor tile and receipt exist, but there are no poses for him.
No pose sheet for the Thirteenth Hand itself (only the two card illustrations and the VFX atlas).

A **top-down table painting for the Underground Tunnels** board: `Card Table Beneath the Sealed Door.png` is an isometric map tile, so `underground_tunnels` keeps its drawn surface (marked "Art coming soon").

No illustrated **town map of Fredericksburg**. The story map lays the nine location tiles along a trail, in story order. Sophia's annotated river map is a clue (evidence), not a town map, and is not used as one.
alpha: Character, item, UI, stamp, map-icon and VFX sheets have real transparency. Several keep stray colour under fully transparent pixels; the pipeline zeroes it so sprite edges don't pick up coloured fringes when scaled.

Ghost characters (Mary Ball Washington, George Washington) and VFX use translucent glows. Cells are cut on opaque artwork only, so the glow is shared at a cell boundary rather than a figure being cut; faint glow below alpha 8 is dropped.

The documents (receipts, commission form, dossier, sketchbook page, letter, puzzle diagram, the two Thirteenth Hand cards) sit on soft, partly transparent paper edges; check them over both dark and light backgrounds before use.
The two card backs are opaque images; the build cuts each card out of its white (navy-gold) or black (tricorn) surround, keeping the rounded corners.
All nine new gameboards are opaque RGB images, as boards should be.
unverified: **All sprite names are mine, from looking at the art.** Character pose names are slot conventions (row = portrait / cards / full body); the meaning of the `special`, `signature` and `gesture-*` slots differs per character (e.g. Cheryl's magnifier, Sophia's binoculars, George Washington's spectral card) and is not confirmed by the artist.
Item names (e.g. `triangle-sigil-coin`, `cipher-ribbon`, `key-13-tag`) describe what is drawn, not how the story uses it. The story meaning of every item, stamp, effect and map icon is unverified.
The twelve passport stamps are named after what they show; which chapter or character each belongs to is my reading, not the artist's.
Map location tiles are identified by their file names; their placement on the river map is not defined anywhere yet.

**Freemasonry** (Engraved Georgian faces + navy-gold back) and **George Washington's Ghost** (Spectral Washington faces + tricorn back) were checked card by card in Prompt 19: rank and suit of all 52 cards by their top-left index, pips and colours. Misprinted bottom-right indices (Freemasonry: the four 9s and K♠; Washington: 9♠, 9♥, 9♦, 9♣, 5♥, 6♣, K♥) are replaced at build time by each card's own top-left index rotated 180° (`indexFixes` in their atlas.json). The four Freemasonry 5s show four pips (not changed; disclosed). The pairing of these faces with these backs is my reading of the art.

**INSPIRE Botanical Cannabis deck** (audited only): the 8 of diamonds reads "7" in its top-left index and shows a heart in its bottom-right corner; the 9 of diamonds also shows a heart in its bottom-right corner; the 3 of spades reads "2" in its top-left index (three pips, bottom index 3). The deck is cannabis-themed and should be treated as adult content (isolated like the other 18+ decks) if it is added.
Nothing in `public/assets/story/` is used by the game yet, and nothing is marked verified (`verified: false` on every sheet).

**Dante's expression row** is drawn in a different order from the other sheets: surprise (with alarm marks), then thinking (hand on chin), then a sideways smirk. Its names in `sources.json` now follow the drawings (checked by eye in the upgrade series); the other six sheets match the standard order.
followUp: Confirm the sprite names in `art/story/sources.json` (especially the per-character `special` / `signature` / `gesture-*` poses and the stamp-to-chapter mapping), then set `verified: true` per sheet.

Where neighbouring poses touch (listed under *Cropping and alpha issues*), ask for a re-export with a little more space between cells; the pipeline cuts where the overlap is smallest, but a few pixels of the neighbour's edge can remain or be lost.
Ask for corrected Freemasonry 5s (four pips each) and corrected bottom indices on both new decks, so the build-time index overlay can be removed.
Re-export the Botanical deck with the 8 of diamonds, 9 of diamonds and 3 of spades corrected before building it, and decide where 18+ content rules apply to it.
Provide a Jak character sheet, and sprite sheets for the Story Mode hosts if they are kept.
Define where each location tile sits on the river map (a coordinate list), so the map screen can be built from data.
Supply a top-down painting for the Underground Tunnels board.

Source-art defects seen in the Story Mode presentation audit (upgrade series), for a re-export, not a CSS fix: Steve Gonzales's `portrait-greet`, `portrait-neutral` and `portrait-talk` are cut at the bottom by the sheet's cell (49, 21 and 32 px); Mary Ball Washington's `portrait-greet` (17 px), Sophia's `portrait-talk`/`portrait-think` and Dante's `portrait-greet`/`portrait-neutral` (8–10 px), and George Washington's `portrait-think`/`portrait-doubt` (22 px) touch or share an edge with a neighbouring pose. Mrs. Gray's badge reads "CIA" in the art, while the story's agency is unnamed; Steve's `portrait-surprise` reads as neutral. Jak still has no pose sheet: his opponent avatar stands in, by design.
